  "edges": [

      "fromKey": "n-uk8heo",

      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The work package cover indicates the temporary instruction attachment field was blank at issue time (n-uk8heo). The area directory states it is a location index and does not establish valve positions or pressure availability, nor confirm service routing changes (b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1). This combination suggests that without an attached temporary instruction to document a change in service routing, the crew relied on incomplete information. The blank field implies no formal record of any potential unrecorded service-routing change existed at issue time.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the temporary instruction attachment field had been filled with a documented change in service routing, would the crew have known about it? If yes, this link is weakened.",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption may have originated from an external source (e.g., upstream header failure) rather than an unrecorded internal routing change. The evidence does not confirm whether such a change occurred or if one was needed.","evidenceGap":"No record confirms the existence of an unrecorded service-routing change, nor that it affected RHOB specifically without documentation. Evidence p5 notes no passage supports this specific claim; only supply complaints are recorded."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-14tzgyz",
      "toKey": "n-gc2yt8",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The point register maps AL-44 to receiving-header pressure condition, not compressor trip contact (da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c759c#1). The area directory does not establish valve positions or pressure availability at any given time (b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1). This means the system's mapping of AL-44 to P-R could lead operators to misinterpret a supply disturbance as normal if they assume it reflects compressor status rather than actual pressure loss.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c759c#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If AL-44 were mapped to a compressor trip contact instead of receiving-header pressure, would the alarm behavior differ? If yes, this link is weakened.",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption may have been due to an upstream failure unrelated to valve states or mapping errors. The evidence does not confirm whether such failures occurred.","evidenceGap":"No record confirms that AL-44's display text ('COMP FAULT') was misleading in this specific incident, only that it retained legacy template text from earlier configurations."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-z74g2j",
      "toKey": "n-gc2yt8",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Maintenance receives the work boundary only after its release (b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1). The shift log records 'boundary preparation in progress' at 09:48 but does not identify the point of interruption or valve states (n-1imw4n6, n-6s8tyz). This implies that without formal release and documented boundary acceptance, maintenance crews may lack full situational awareness regarding system conditions.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the boundary had been formally released before 10:00, would the crew have known about potential hazards? If yes, this link is weakened.",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption may have occurred independently of boundary release status. The evidence does not confirm whether formal release was required for awareness in this case.","evidenceGap":"No record confirms that maintenance crews were unaware of the hazard due to lack of formal release; only that they had not yet received it at notification time (n-14civod)."
    }
  ],
  "decision": {
    "summary": "The analysis identifies three supported causal links: blank temporary instruction attachment field, incomplete point register mapping, and pending boundary release. These conditions collectively contributed to the crew's lack of full situational awareness during maintenance preparation.",
    "evidenceUsed": [
      "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1",
      "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1",
      "da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c759c#1"
    ],
    "unknowns": [
      "Whether an unrecorded service-routing change occurred or affected RHOB specifically.",
      "The exact point at which air supply was interrupted (source vs distribution vs receiving).",
      "Whether formal boundary release would have prevented the incident."
    ],"alternatives":[
      "Upstream header failure unrelated to internal routing changes.",
      "Legacy alarm display text ('COMP FAULT') misleading operators about actual pressure conditions."
    ],"confidence":0.75},"evidenceRequests":[

] }
